name: l2_scn_0805_the_ship_that_must_survive_v1
about: L2 scenario seed SCN-0805 (The Ship That Must Survive) overlaid on an Orion Station watch. A ship becomes a sealed city under pursuit or isolation. A small failure cascades through life-support and trust networks while decisions must be made with imperfect data. The seed is a pressure field and initial-condition template: roles, pressure axes, and knobs shape the run; expected end states are observation categories, never required endings. Root fixture only; not canon.
